ios-navigation|Page controls.summary: A Plenix page control on iOS is the system page control, kept native in behavior (tapping and scrubbing to change pages, the animated change, VoiceOver’s adjustable page value) with its indicator colors set to Plenix content roles that keep the system’s contrast relation: the current page in the default content color, the other pages in the strong border color, in both themes. It sits centered near the bottom of the view. Apple’s default uses the system label colors; Plenix keeps the system control, its sizes and its background styles.

variants.name: Minimal
variants.appkit: No page control; dots drawn beside an NSPageController
variants.use: A carousel of peer pages, such as a set of media or onboarding screens, where the dots only show the position.

variants.name: Prominent
variants.appkit: No page control; dots drawn beside an NSPageController
variants.use: When the page control is the main way to move between pages and scrubbing should be easy to find.
